# Prime numbers

This file develops the theory of prime numbers: natural numbers `p ≥ 2` whose only divisors are
`p` and `1`.

-/

public section

namespace Nat
variable {n : ℕ}
assert_not_exists _root_.Nat.prime_mul_iff
task.proposition: Nat.Prime (a * b) ↔ a.Prime ∧ b = 1 ∨ b.Prime ∧ a = 1
